LOTTE CHEMICAL PAKISTAN LTD
NOTICEOFBOOK CLOSURE
Under Regulation 9 of the Listed Companies
(Substantial Acquisition Of Voting Shares
and Takeovers) Regulations, 2017
It is hereby notified that the share transfer books of
Lotte Chemical Pakistan Limited will remain closed from
17 August 2025 to 23 August 2025 (both days
inclusive) to determine the eligibility of persons to
receive offer letters in connection with the Public
Announcement of Offer for the acquisition of up to
189,173,552 ordinary shares of Lotte Chemical Pakistan
Limited by PTA Global Holding Limited with Liberty
Daharki Power Limited and Daewoo Pakistan Express
Bus Service Limited acting in concert, as published on
12 July 2025 in Business Recorder and Nawa-i-Waqt
newspapers.
Karachi
Faisal Abid
1st August 2025
Company Secretary
